description:
Write notes: add or edit task notes (human-readable updates) and sticky notes, and write a task's markdown document or an entry of its AI Context (private cross-session memory). Overwrites what an edit replaces.

Pass one of these as `action`, with its arguments in `params`:
- karea_add_note - Add a note to a task - or the same note to many tasks at once, via `tasks`. [required: content; optional: task, tasks, projectId, aiSessionId, toolType, sessionLabel]
- karea_edit_note - Change the text of an existing note on a task, by note ID, and return the updated note. [required: task, noteId, content; optional: projectId, aiSessionId, toolType, sessionLabel]
- karea_create_sticky_note - Pin a short note to the user's sticky board - a command, a URL, a couple of lines to remember. [required: content; optional: title, color, projectId, pinned]
- karea_edit_sticky_note - Change a sticky note: its text, title, colour, pin state, or which project it belongs to. [required: noteId; optional: content, title, color, projectId, pinned]
- karea_set_markdown - Write the markdown document for a task. [required: task, markdown; optional: projectId, aiSessionId, toolType, sessionLabel]
- karea_set_context - Write a titled entry of the task's Context - the AI-facing cross-session working memory. [required: task, context; optional: title, projectId, aiSessionId, toolType, sessionLabel]

For the full parameter schema of any action, call karea_help with that action name.

action.description: Which operation to perform. See the list in this tool's description.

params.description: Arguments for the chosen action, as an object. Omit for actions that take none.

name: karea_notes_write
title: Write notes and task documents
